name: Cohort-2-Beta-Builders
headline: Cohort 2 NFT: On-Chain Learning Badge
short_description: A collaborative GitHub workspace for MGSWeb3 Cohort 2: Beta Builders across design, writing, marketing, research, and content creation
author: MGSWeb3

sections.overview:
The Cohort 2 NFT is a digital badge of belonging designed to recognize participation and contributions within the MGSWeb3 learning experience. Rather than traditional participation certificates, this NFT serves as verifiable on-chain proof of engagement, completion, and skills developed during the program. The design draws from African art and community symbolism, reflecting the cohort's collective learning journey in the Web3 ecosystem. Holders gain permanent digital documentation of their involvement while becoming part of MGSWeb3's decentralized community ownership model. The NFT may provide future utility through access to alumni events, collaborations, and exclusive opportunities.
Documenting on-chain proof of Web3 learning program completion
Creating digital proof of community participation and skills development
Building verifiable credentials for Web3 portfolio and reputation
Accessing exclusive alumni events and collaboration opportunities
Welcome to the collaborative workspace for MGSWeb3 Cohort 2: Beta Builders. This space is designed to foster collaboration among team members in design, writing, marketing, research, and content creation.
